title: New report shows the economic toll of ICE raids
content: A new study shows the steep economic cost of 2025's ICE raids in Chicago. Fear kept many immigrants home, draining the area of more than $1.26 billion in lost retail, restaurant, and sales-tax revenue.

title: Kenya's foreign trader crackdown sparks fear among migrant communities
content: Kenya's president orders a crackdown on foreigners running small businesses, amid accusations of xenophobia.

title: Australian social media users to be offered choice to opt out of algorithms
content: A government statement said on Tuesday social media platforms would be required to send a notification to new and existing users offering them a choice over their default feed.

title: U.K. accuses Israeli settlers of 'ethnic cleansing' in West Bank and bans their goods
content: France, Canada and other countries joined the U.K. in banning goods from Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank. Israel said it would close the British Consulate among other measures.

title: Whatever happened to the Taliban threat: 'We will flog the women'?
content: In 2024, the ruling Taliban pledged to use flogging as well as stoning to punish people for not following certain of their precepts — committing adultery, running secret schools for girls. Have they followed through?

title: GOP to host unusual midterm convention. And, Canada's retaliatory tariffs take effect
content: Republicans are aiming to get voters to turn out for the midterms with an unconventional convention. And, Canada's retaliatory tariffs on the U.S. went into effect at midnight.

title: Chrystia Freeland negotiated with Trump. Now she's watching a trade war unfold
content: Chrystia Freeland understands the U.S.-Canada relationship from her time at the negotiating table. Here's what she sees now.

title: Has the economy gone C-shaped?
content: A K means the rich and poor are pulling apart. A C supposedly means they're coming back together. We hear the case for both. Which letter you see may depend on what you choose to pay attention to.

title: Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia ignite fires at oil facilities and wound 73 people
content: The attacks come after weeks of escalating clashes between the Houthis and Saudi-backed government forces in Yemen, which shattered a four-year truce in the country's civil war.

title: The 2026 midterm general election season is upon us. Here's what to watch
content: The week of Labor Day marks the unofficial kickoff of the general election season. President Trump's unpopularity and Democratic enthusiasm means control of Congress is on the ballot.
